library(tidyverse)
library(ggprop.test)
library(ggchalkboard)


{dolphin_data |> 
  ggplot() + 
  labs(title = "Is there evidence that Doris and Buzz Communicate 🐬🐬🐟🪣") +
  aes(x = observed) + 
  geom_stack() + 
  geom_stack_label() + 
  geom_support() +
  geom_prop() + 
  geom_prop_label() + 
  stamp_prop(.5) + 
  stamp_prop_label(.5) + 
  geom_binomial_null(.5) } |>
